name: Kamoenai (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kamoenai village emblem in orange and blue: an orange three-lobed device like a fountain, with a blue stylised bird.
history: Municipal flag of Kamoenai, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 May 1968.

features.role: Kamoenai village emblem — an orange three-lobed device like a fountain, with a blue stylised bird
